City Centre (Ward 11) — Edinburgh, United Kingdom

🟡 Local-source safety assessment · 17 areas reviewed individually · analysis of Police Scotland figures Methodology →

Higher caution advised Safety level (no day/night split in the source data)

In detail

By far Edinburgh's highest-crime ward: 267.7 crimes per 1,000 population in 2023/24, more than double the next-highest ward and driven by the dense concentration of pubs, clubs, tourist footfall and retail theft in the Old Town/New Town core. Genuine, dated local press coverage also documents recurring nightlife-related disturbances specifically around the Cowgate/Grassmarket area: on the night of 20 September 2025 police responded to a disturbance outside a Grassmarket bar in which a 28-year-old man was hospitalised and a 39-year-old man was arrested and charged (Edinburgh News, 21 Sep 2025). Day and night are both red here on the strength of the underlying rate alone; the Cowgate/Grassmarket incident is additional, specific corroboration for the night rating rather than the basis for it. Sources checked: Churchill Support Services / Scottish Daily Express, 28 Nov 2024; datamap-scotland.co.uk Police Scotland ward crime map, data to end 2025; Edinburgh News, 21 Sep 2025 (Grassmarket/Cowgate disturbance).

Frequently asked questions

Is City Centre (Ward 11) safe?

Wandroz currently rates City Centre (Ward 11) in Edinburgh as an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Edinburgh. This comes from a structured local-source assessment: an area-level review of credible local sources — local and national news, municipal and police-published material, and official surveys where they exist — consolidated across sources rather than taken from a single report. Edinburgh publishes no comparable neighbourhood-level crime dataset; where a city does, Wandroz uses it instead. The source data has no day/night breakdown, so this single rating applies at any time of day rather than being a distinct night-specific figure.

Does City Centre (Ward 11)'s rating differ between day and night?

No — City Centre (Ward 11)'s source data has no time-of-day breakdown, so the same rating (an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Edinburgh) is shown for both day and night rather than Wandroz inventing a separate night figure it doesn't actually have.

Is City Centre (Ward 11) a good area to stay in as a tourist?

City Centre (Ward 11)'s day rating (an area where the data suggests extra caution relative to other neighbourhoods in Edinburgh) is the more relevant one for typical daytime tourist activity; check the night rating too if you'll be out late. Is there official crime data for City Centre (Ward 11)?

Not an official government crime feed — City Centre (Ward 11)'s rating comes from Wandroz's own current local/national press and survey research for this specific area instead (see the note on this page for what was checked and the sources used). An absence of recent negative coverage is treated as inconclusive, not as proof the area is safe.
